1 : 12 : 7 Anchingni dongchakenggipa ia , dal begipa, agilsak chengonin dongbaengade ongjachim.
Skangode a'gil- sakandongsrangkujachim.
Ching'gipa sal, tengigipa rangba dongjachim.
Indiba, Isol gnangchim; maina ua pangnan donga aro jringjrotnan uan uan ong-anggen.
Isol ruutbea, bilsirangna skangan agilsakko ong:- ataha.
Ua a'gilsak dao an'chingni nikenggipa gitade ongjachim; maina chi aro andala pilakni kosako, ong-engachim.
Aiao, ua a'gilsak mairongpile dingtang- gipa aro nitogijagipa ongenggenchim!
Uano, mamung janggi gnanggipaba tange, dongna man'jachim.
Indiba Isol uko nitoatna chanchie sengako ongataha.
Ua sengako sal aro andalako wal mingaha.
Unon skang- gipa sal badeangaha.
Gnigipa salo nitogipa, tangsimgipa bangbangko ong'- ataha."Chini jatchio bangbangko ongatahani gimin uni kosako aro' kokkimaoba chi gnangchim.
Ua bang- bangkon salgi mingaha.
Gittamgipa salo ua bangbangni kokkimao donggipa dakataha aro ua tomdakgimin  chirangko sagalrang mingaha.
,Unon ran'gipa a'a nakataha aro iako ua aa mingaha.
Indimangba uano chagipa sam bolrang dongkujachim.
..A'a gimikan , porongrong aro bang- bang ong'engpitichim.
Uni gimin Isol porongronggipa a-ani kosako sam bolrangko chaataha aro bibalrangko balataha.
Samjakrang aro bolrangkoba ua an'tangni ska gita: chaataha.
Isol, antangni ong-atgiminko nie nitoniktokaha aro nama ine inaha.
Brigipa salo ua tangsimgipa salgio dal-dalbegipa, --- Page 8 --- chinggipa teng'sugiparingko ongataha, jerangko an'.

Indiba, Adam aro Hobani barini songni nitoa gita .pilakba bariko nitoate tarina amjawa ine an-ching uina mana.
Ua barini songni jatchio Isol aiao inmanpilgipa bolko, Janggini bol minggipako chaataha., Ia bolni biteko saoba chaode ua jringjrotna tanggenchim.
